title: Chapter 239 Master Qiao
content:
Chapter 239 Master Qiao

The alchemy will continue, and the departure of Lu Xue and the other two will not have any impact on the alchemy.

That is, it just made everyone talk for a while.

After the disciples in the Alchemy Peak appeared one after another.

Everyone immediately began to look at it with their breath holding their minds.

On the other side.

"Sister Lu, wait, wait for me!"

Xiao Luo trotted all the way to catch up with Lu Xue.

Although Lu Xue's face was not ugly at this time, she could still tell that she was not in a good mood.

"Sister Lu, are you okay?"

Xiao Luo asked with some concern.

Hearing this, Lu Xue's face was expressionless.

"What can I do? Isn't it just a way to break the alchemy? I don't care."

As he said that, Lu Xue seemed to have thought of something, and then a pill appeared out of thin air in her hand and threw it directly to Xiao Luo.

"Will this be for you."

Looking at the white pills that were only the size of a fingernail in his hand, Xiao Luo was a little stunned.

"This is,,"

Xiao Luo put it on the tip of his nose and sniffed it, but he smelled the faint fragrance of medicine, which was very different from the elixirs that were fragrant in the alchemy.

"Sister Lu, where did you come from?"

"My father gave it to me, what's wrong?"

Hearing this, Xiao Luo waved his hand quickly, "No, nothing."

Xiao Luo wiped the cold sweat from his forehead.

He just suspected that the pill was a fake medicine, so he deserved to die.

How could the things given by that senior be fake?

Thinking of this, Xiao Luo prepared to carefully put away the elixir and preserve it for a long time.

Never eat until absolutely necessary.

And at this moment, a rapid figure suddenly passed by Xiao Luo.

The next moment, Xiao Luo suddenly discovered that the pill in his hand was gone!

"Damn, where is my medicine?!"

Xiao Luo immediately looked around and suddenly saw an old man with red eyebrows suddenly appearing on the side.

At this moment, the old man with red eyebrows was staring at the pill in his hand with shock.

The pill held by the old man with red eyebrows was exactly the one Lu Xue gave him just now.

Seeing this, Xiao Luo was about to speak, but the old man swallowed the pill directly.

At this moment, Xiao Luo was completely stunned.

"I***, Lao Biden, you***."

In desperation, Xiao Luo did not notice that the old man was wearing the exclusive clothing of the instructor.

On the side, Lu Xue was also shocked when facing the old man who suddenly appeared.

Just as Lu Xue was about to ask, the old man suddenly said excitedly: "Who made this pill?!"

boom!

Suddenly, a terrifying aura at the peak of the Immortal Emperor Realm suddenly overflowed from the old man's body without control.

Feeling the old man's aura, Xiao Luo suddenly became depressed.

Damn, the peak of the Immortal Emperor!

Can't afford to offend. .

The next moment, Xiao Luo hurriedly hid behind Lu Xue.

"The Peak of the Immortal Emperor? Are you the mentor of the Alchemy Peak?"

Lu Xue asked.

Hearing Lu Xue's words, the old man did not hide his identity and nodded decisively, "That's right, it's me."

Hearing this, Lu Xue nodded.

He is dressed in the unique clothes of the mentor, and has the peak cultivation level of the Immortal Emperor Realm, and has the fragrance of medicine.

Except for Jordanyang, the one in the alchemy peak, Lu Xue couldn't think of a second place.

"Boy, you haven't told me yet, who made this pill?"

Jordanyang looked at Xiao Luo behind Lu Xue and continued to ask the question just now.

"Master Qiao, this is not something I have refined."

After knowing the identity of the old man with red eyebrows in front of him, Xiao Luo suddenly became a little nervous.

The strange old man in front of me was actually Jordanyang, the most famous alchemy master in the entire fairyland!

It's so ashamed to know it in this way.

Hearing Xiao Luo's answer, Jordan Yang's mouth twitched slightly.

"Aren't you talking nonsense? If you can refine this pill, that's all. I can go home and smash the alchemy furnace."

"Hahaha."

Jordan Yang's words made Lu Xue laugh.

Xiao Luo's face was also slightly red, and he scratched his head in awkward manner.

"This pill was given to me by my father."

At this time, Lu Xue told Jordanyang directly.

"Your father?"

Jordanyang frowned slightly.

Lu Xue nodded, "It's my father."

"This pill is the highest-grade pill I have ever seen since my life, and it is even better than the Immortal Emperor Pill. Is your father also an alchemist?"

Hearing this, Lu Xue was about to shake her head, but suddenly she thought that she had never seen any alchemist around her father.

Maybe, this pill was really refined by my father.

Seeing that Lu Xue didn't say anything, Jordan Yang immediately laughed.

“Funny, fun.”

"This fairy realm is really a crouching tiger, hidden dragon."

Speaking of this, Jordanyang looked at Lu Xue and chuckled, "Little girl, I am very interested in meeting your father now. If you have the chance, it would be okay to compete."

Jordanyang smiled, as if he had finally found an opponent.

Hearing this, Lu Xue hesitated for a moment, then nodded and said, "That's OK, he is in the deserted city of the Wood Immortal Realm. You will see him when you go."

"Muxian Realm?"

Jordan Yang was slightly stunned, and then murmured: "No wonder I have never heard of such an alchemy powerhouse in the fairyland. It turns out that he lives in seclusion in that kind of place."

"Since that's the case, I'll go on."

Immediately, Jordanyang was about to set off for the Wood Fairy Realm.

And at this moment, a figure ran towards him from afar.

The three of them heard the movement and turned their heads to look.

"Huh? That's not Brother Qin."

The person who came here had already left the alchemy to get Qin Feng.

"Miss Lu, Xiao,, huh?! Master Qiao?!"

Qin Feng was about to say hello to the two when he suddenly found that the old man standing beside Lu Xue and the others was Master Qiao, Jordanyang.

"Oh? It turns out it's the boy from Tianjian Peak."

"My younger brother Qin Feng, I have met Master Qiao."

Qin Feng immediately saluted Jordanyang respectfully.

Jordanyang nodded and asked, "Isn't it possible to refine alchemy now? Why don't you go? You have never been absent before."

Hearing this, Qin Feng sighed slightly, turned his head to look at Lu Xue and the others beside him, and was silent for a moment, then told Jordanyang what had just happened to refine the alchemy.

After a long time.

"Exited?"

Jordan Yang's red eyebrows suddenly frowned, and his expression was a little unkind.

At this time, Qin Feng lowered his head tightly.

He knew that Jordanyang had a bad temper and was definitely the worst among all the mentors.

Students studying under Jordan Yang don’t know how much scolding they will get on weekdays.

I thought Jordan Yang would curse directly at the three of them, saying that they were ungrateful, but the next moment, Jordan Yang actually said to Lu Xue: "This girl didn't say anything big."

"Um?!"

When Qin Feng heard this, he suddenly raised his head.

Jordanyang smiled bitterly and said, "I have only refined that kind of elixir once in my life, and my quality is incomparable."

"It's normal for this girl to look down on her."

At this moment, Qin Feng was a little doubted whether he was having auditory hallucinations.

Is this the arrogant and complacent Master Qiao I know?
